questions.question_text: Communication barrier is anything that ________ communication.
questions.answer: A barrier is an obstacle that impedes or hinders the successful transfer of a message.

questions.question_text: Strict rules are ________ barrier in communication.
questions.answer: Strict hierarchies and rules within a company are classified as organizational barriers to communication.

questions.question_text: It is the process of decoding symbols and saying aloud.
questions.answer: Reading involves decoding written symbols (text) and interpreting or voicing them.

questions.question_text: Grapevine communication is an ________ way of communication.
questions.answer: The grapevine refers to the informal, unofficial flow of information in an organization.

questions.question_text: The response of the sender message is called ________.
questions.answer: Feedback is the receiver's response or reaction sent back to the original sender.

questions.question_text: Haptics is a ________ communication.
questions.answer: Haptics is the study of communicating through touch, which is a form of nonverbal communication.

questions.question_text: She is one of the girls who ________ won a number of medals.
questions.answer: "Who" refers to the plural "girls," so the plural verb "have" must be used.

questions.question_text: ________ is a device that converts chemical energy into electrical energy.
questions.answer: A battery chemically stores energy and converts it to electrical energy upon discharge.
questions.chapter: Unit 2 - English: The Language of Science & Technology

questions.question_text: Instructions which encourage live participation and interaction through online classes are called ________
questions.answer: Live, real-time participation in online classes represents synchronous communication.

questions.question_text: The meaning of netiquette is ________.
questions.answer: Netiquette is a portmanteau for "internet etiquette."

questions.question_text: Which one of the followings is irrelevant to synchronous communication?
questions.answer: E-mails are typically read and answered at a later time, making them asynchronous.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct parallel structure: Priya likes ________
questions.answer: Parallel structure requires all listed verbs to take the gerund (-ing) form.

questions.question_text: Searching for a specific piece of information is ________
questions.answer: Scanning involves sweeping over text rapidly to locate specific data or keywords.

questions.question_text: Neither of the answers ________ correct.
questions.answer: "Neither" is grammatically singular and takes the singular verb "is."

questions.question_text: It is used to highlight a product, company or service.
questions.answer: A brochure is an informative paper document used specifically for marketing or advertising products/services.

questions.question_text: Feasibility report is a result of ________
options: survey to find out the possibilities of something
controlling problems, sell products and services
monitoring and control production, sales, shipping, etc
questions.answer: A feasibility report evaluates the practicality and chances of success of a proposed plan.

questions.question_text:
Fill in the gap with suitable connectives.
Our teacher thinks that Rahul is poor in his studies. ________, it is he who secured the highest marks in the class.
questions.answer: "However" is used to introduce a statement that contrasts with the previous clause.

questions.question_text: She ________ an assignment since this morning.
questions.answer: 'Since this morning' needs the present perfect continuous: 'has been writing'. Option B is that form (printed with the typo 'witting'); 'had been writing' (past perfect) and 'have been writing' (wrong agreement with 'She') do not fit.

questions.question_text: Project proposal is a ________
options: document showing a plan of action
questions.answer: A project proposal proposes a specific plan of action to address a problem or opportunity.

questions.question_text: It is the official list of items to be discussed in a particular meeting.
questions.answer: The agenda lists all the activities and discussion points planned for a meeting.
